overview_description.description: INTEREL is a technology company that develops smart building and hospitality automation solutions. Founded in 2010 and headquartered in Dubai, the company focuses on connecting devices, systems, and people through Internet-of-Things (IoT) infrastructure to create more efficient and sustainable buildings.
